# Alexa Lashes

> Eyelash extension studio in Bratislava – Petržalka, Slovakia. Classic 1D, 2D, 3-4D and 5-6D volume lashes, refills, lash removal, and eyelash extension training courses for beginners and advanced lash artists. Lash master and instructor: Oleksandra Afanasieva.

- Address: Pajštúnska 1, 851 01 Bratislava – Petržalka, Slovakia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +421 951 268 876
- Opening hours: Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday and Sunday closed
- Rating: 5.0 from 53 reviews on Google Maps
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15930515621788203838
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/alexa_lashes_bratislava
- Booking: by WhatsApp, phone or the contact form
- Languages spoken: Slovak, Russian, Ukrainian
- Website languages: Slovak (default, no prefix), English (/en), Russian (/ru)

## Prices (EUR)

| Style | New set | Refill 2 weeks | Refill 3 weeks | Refill 4 weeks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Classic 1D | 60 | 40 | 45 | 50 |
| 2D volume | 70 | 45 | 50 | 55 |
| 3-4D volume | 80 | 50 | 55 | 60 |
| 5-6D volume | 90 | 55 | 60 | 65 |

Add-ons: Kim Kardashian style lash clusters 5, special curl M/L 5, colored (brown) lashes 5, lash removal 15.
